subject: MedicaX demo — request to shift around EU summer maintenance window
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Brown <sarah.brown@medicax.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: MedicaX demo — request to shift around EU summer maintenance window

Hi Sarah,

Quick note — I wanted to confirm our upcoming product demo on Monday, 19 July at 11:00 CET. Laura and I are excited to walk through the integration and the SOW milestones you flagged. I attached the latest SOW and the demo deck for reference.

Before I lock the calendar, Marcus flagged a potential conflict on our side: the backend infra team has a maintenance/ops-freeze window and limited bench coverage the week of Jul 19–23.

If that could impact any live demonstration of the production connector (we normally bring a staging node up for the walkthrough), I wanted to surface it now and offer alternative windows: 26–30 July or the week of 2 August. If you prefer we can also run a short recorded walkthrough and Q&A with smaller team coverage on the 19th — just let me know which option you prefer.

Proposed next steps:
- If you can do week of Jul 26, tell us a couple of slots and we’ll confirm.
- If 19 Jul is essential, we’ll run the recorded + live Q&A work-around.

Thanks — Olga

--
Olga Petrov
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com

Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 14:10:00 +0100
Subject: Re: MedicaX demo — request to shift around EU summer maintenance window

Olga, Laura —

Short heads-up from ops: the EU infra team will be running a controlled maintenance and reduced support rota from 19–23 Jul for planned upgrades and mandatory compliance checks. We can still do demos, but the full staging environment might not be available for load-based or connector live-tests.

Options we recommend:
1) Move the full demo (with staging connector) to Aug 2–6 — full coverage from infra, Product and SRE.
2) If customer needs any date in the week of Jul 19, run a sandbox-only demo + recorded run of the connector in prod + a live Q&A. This reduces risk but means some interactive tests won’t be possible.

If you want, I can mark Aug 3–4 as tentative reserved slots and unblock infra for a single-day exception, but that requires escalation to the SRE lead (and a week lead-time).

— Marcus
Senior Infrastructure Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Brown <sarah.brown@medicax.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Keller <tkeller@medicax.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 18:04:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: MedicaX demo — request to shift around EU summer maintenance window

Thanks for the heads-up, Olga — and thanks Marcus for the details.

MedicaX would ideally prefer one of the last days of July (week of Jul 26) because our procurement team wants to sign the SOW before the end of the month. Tom and I are traveling the week of Aug 2–6 for an on-site, so Aug is tight for us.

We’re flexible on exact time — afternoons CET are best. If moving to week of Jul 26 won’t affect the staging checks you need, that works for us. If not, we can do the recorded + live Q&A on Jul 19 as a fallback.

Also, I attached the redline we’ve sent to legal (filename: MedicaX_SOW_v3.pdf) — Laura, flagged any items we should be aware of before the demo?

Best,
Sarah
Director of Product, MedicaX

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Brown <sarah.brown@medicax.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 16:45:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: MedicaX demo — request to shift around EU summer maintenance window

Thanks Sarah — that’s helpful.

Laura: quick read on the SOW redlines would be great; I’ll track offline with legal if needed.

Plan for schedule:
- Tentative: move full demo to Tue, 27 Jul 2026 at 14:00 CET (45 min walkthrough + 15 min Q&A). That matches MedicaX preference and should be before procurement closes.
- If infra flags any staging risk, we’ll fall back to a recorded connector run for the first 20 minutes and then a 30-minute live Q&A on the 27th.
- If any approvals are required to unblock Aug dates (Tom, procurement), we can keep Aug 3 as an alternative but I won’t block it unless you confirm.

I’m attaching the demo deck and will send an official calendar invite once you confirm the 27th. If the 27th works, please reply with a quick "Confirm" and I’ll send the invite. If not, suggest two 1-hour windows during Jul 26–30 that suit you.

Attachments: demo-deck-redwood-v2.pdf (slides), MedicaX_SOW_v3.pdf (from Sarah)

Thanks again — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Olga
